newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Aug 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates' press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The new Federal Traffic Law, imposing heavy fines on traffic offenders, will go into effect on September 1.
- A Dubai court deports two Africans found guilty of fraud.
- Infant mortality in the UAE drops to 10 per 1,000 in the 1990s.
- Abu Dhabi to expand airport facilities at a cost of some $320 million. The project involves a 60-metre-wide second runway.
- Dubai attracted 45,000 German visitors last year.
- In 1996 Japanese car exports to UAE grew 19 percent to 60,000 units compared to 50,918 in 1995.
- The cost of new buildings in Dubai in the first half of 1997 has reached 2.42 billion dirhams.
- Iraq praises a call by UAE president for the lifting of sanctions on Baghdad.
